entries.09b1d11a2f5fbb11: It manufactures and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients for veterinary drugs. Revenue increased for fluralaner, which is used in veterinary drugs such as those for pets. Amounts are not separately disclosed by category.
entries.0ae9dce0dfa9be4a: It manufactures and sells inorganic colloids, including abrasives for electronic materials and various surface treatment agents. Its products include “Snowtex” and oil and gas materials used to improve the efficiency of shale oil and gas extraction. Amounts are not separately disclosed by category.
entries.0cdad61a9393db36: It manufactures and sells agricultural chemicals, including herbicides, insecticides, fungicides, insecticidal fungicides and plant growth regulators. Its products include the paddy herbicides “Altair” and “Belder” and the fungicide “Raimei,” among others. Amounts are not separately disclosed by category.

entries.221846d20f38c007: This is a business engaged in fertilizers (such as high-analysis compound fertilizers), landscaping and greening, transportation, plant engineering, sulfuric acid production, and the manufacture and sale of electronic materials. These operations are handled by Nihon Hiryo Co., Ltd., Nissan Butsuryu Co., Ltd., Nissan Ryokka Co., Ltd., Nissan Engineering Co., Ltd., NC Tokyo Bay Co., Ltd., and Nihon Politec Co., Ltd., among others. entries.781c7d89aaf25a62: A chemical manufacturer that handles everything from basic chemicals such as sulfuric acid to semiconductor materials, agrochemicals and active pharmaceutical ingredients, and also operates a chemicals wholesale business.

Its subsidiary Nissei Sangyo Co., Ltd. takes the lead and also sells the company’s products and engages in insurance agency business. entries.b478bd77402f0e14: It manufactures and sells the active pharmaceutical ingredient for the hypercholesterolemia treatment “Livalo.” Amounts are not separately disclosed by category.
entries.bd5ca51bd428b15b: It manufactures and sells agricultural chemicals, including herbicides, insecticides and fungicides, and active pharmaceutical ingredients for veterinary drugs. Sales grew for the paddy herbicide “Altair” and the fungicide “Raimei,” and revenue also increased for the veterinary drug active ingredient fluralaner. entries.cc42775b55533862: It manufactures and sells functional materials in three fields: display materials, semiconductor materials and inorganic colloids. Anti-reflection coatings for semiconductors and other products grew significantly, reflecting strong operating rates at customers, and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥78,310 million.
entries.ce4d3e5f4a98905c: It manufactures and sells basic chemicals such as sulfuric acid, nitric acid and ammonia. High-purity sulfuric acid is used as a cleaning agent for semiconductors, and urea is used in high-grade urea solution such as “AdBlue.” Amounts are not separately disclosed by category.
entries.da95e69251bf900c: This is a solution-oriented contract business engaged in contract manufacturing of active pharmaceutical ingredients and other activities. Amounts are not separately disclosed by category.
entries.df44baa1ce9fc8db: It manufactures and sells semiconductor materials, including anti-reflection coatings for semiconductors and multilayer materials. Revenue increased significantly, reflecting strong operating rates at customers. Amounts are not separately disclosed by category.
entries.e687304eecae0f93: It manufactures and sells basic chemicals such as sulfuric acid, nitric acid and ammonia, and fine chemicals such as specialty epoxies for sealing materials, flame retardants and disinfectants. It also handles high-purity sulfuric acid used for semiconductor cleaning, and high-grade urea water "AdBlue," which is used to purify exhaust gas from diesel vehicles. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥126,198 million, the largest of its six businesses.
entries.ea8b0cea09370a10: It manufactures and sells specialty epoxies for sealing materials, flame retardants, sterilizing and disinfecting agents, and other products. It also handles Fine Oxocol, a raw material for cosmetics. Amounts are not separately disclosed by category.
entries.f994bca92a088c36: It manufactures and sells display materials, including polyimide for liquid crystal alignment films “SUNEVER.” Amounts are not separately disclosed by category.
